notes.title: Mad Devils: Damned-finitive Edition - Plays Great on Steam Deck!
notes.content:
Squad!  Listen up!

We're absolutely thrilled to announce that Mad Devils: Damned-finitive Edition is, to our knowledge, completely compatible with the Steam Deck!

Our team has been diving deep into the hellish landscapes on Valve's awesome handheld, and we're stoked to report that Mad Devils runs smoothly and plays great. We've put it through its paces to ensure you can take your Nazi-slaying, demon-powered adventure with you wherever you are.

So, if you've been itching to blast through the circles of hell on the go, now's your chance! We've worked to make the experience seamless on the Steam Deck.

We can't wait for you to try out Mad Devils: Damned-finitive Edition on your Steam Deck. Grab yours, jump in, and show those demonic Nazis who's boss, whether you're on your couch or on the move!

Happy Nazi hunting!

- The Itzy Interactive Team

notes.title: Mad Devils: Damned-finitive Edition Announced
notes.content:
Get ready to raise hell as Itzy Interactive Inc. unleashes Mad Devils: Damned-finitive Edition, the ultimate demon-fueled WWII shooter, on August 13, 2024. Available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S and as a free upgrade on Steam, this enhanced edition takes the co-op arcade experience to the next level.

Two New Heroes Join the Fight:
[list]
[*]The roster of playable demon soldiers expands from six to eight, each with unique abilities and weapons, ready to unleash hell on the battlefield.
[/list]

Damned-finitive Enhancements:
[list]
[*] Improved Post-Game: Continue the fight after completing the campaign, replay levels with any character, and unlock new challenges.
[*] Enhanced Arsenal: Elemental weapon upgrades have been boosted, unleashing devastating new effects and strategies against the demonic hordes. Fire, ice, and light and dark will bend to your will as you obliterate your foes in spectacular fashion.
[*] Streamlined UI: Refined menu navigation and clearer information for a more intuitive interface.
[*] Countless Fixes and Improvements: Numerous bug fixes, performance enhancements, and quality-of-life updates ensure the smoothest and most enjoyable Mad Devils experience yet.
[*] Steam Deck Support: Take the demonic action on the go with upcoming Steam Deck support.
[/list]

Prepare for the Damned-finitive demon-hunting experience as Mad Devils: Damned-finitive Edition arrives on August 13th. Hell hath no fury like a squad of resurrected soldiers with a score to settle!

If you're attending Gamescom 2024, find us on the floor and play the new demo![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39195600/2396b259d717d836f334737feea1eacad024a150.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 1.0.7
notes.content:
[b]Balance[/b]
Increasing Bat and Heavy Health values for longer interactions 
Added 'hint' mortar shots
When players aren't near any active artillery camps, a stray mortar shell will occasionally fly by from the direction of an uncleared cam.  This shell has a longer lasting smoke trail, in the hopes of leading players towards the camp
Fixed issue where character health was set from wrong source
Increasing health of Demon Dogs and Heavy Grunts to be more reflective of their physical size/aggressiveness

[b]Enclaves[/b]
Added opening instructions text
Added delay between level load and enemy spawn
Added results/reward text before reloading level
Buffed rewards on timed enclave
Enclaves can now spawn between different random encounters
Added more encounters
Adjusted existing encounter difficulty
Rebalanced rewards
Fixed enemies not spawning if enclave checkpoint data is not cleared properly
All remaining enemies will die on enclave success

notes.title: Here's what we've been working on
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39195600/125c375453e5c1fe4af0bd7d970ff47c351a88f8.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

As we work towards our PC launch, we're constantly seeking to improve Mad Devils. With that in mind, here's what the latest patch has improved. Don't worry, there's plenty more besides this and there's lots we still want to do in the coming months.

[list]
[*] Map functioning on Pause Menu with fog of war
[*] Camera distance adjusted based on feedback received
[*] Added new VFX overall
[*] Level up bugs addressed
[*] Added more save points to later levels
[*] Fixed bug where enemies continue to move after death
[*] Diana Shadow Attack crashes game
[*] Implemented Achievements and Achievement tracking system
[*] Placed hidden collectables in levels
[*] Added more checkpoints in desert level
[*] Filled in missing character dialogue in Greed
[*] Varied weapon VFX
[*] Fixed Chester premature rocket explosions
[*] Fixed issues with “shiney” terrain
[*] Fixed shadow issues in swamp level
[*] Added support for additional controllers
[*] Fixed issue with periodic friendly fire
[*] Fixed issues with fog
[*] Fixed texture stretching in swamp level
[*] Issue where some enemies were spawning outside playable area
[*] Balanced Nachtkrapp difficulty
[*] Fixed terrain issues in Enclave locations
[*] Flame thrower enemies can’t stop their flames
[*] Balanced physics recoil on player hit
[*] Frag grenades sometimes penetrated the ground
[*] Added ability to steer character while dashing
[/list]

As always, if you've any feedback for the team, please do let us know.

/MadDevils

notes.title: Here's What We've Been Working On
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39195600/75a8907c1c5f8aa1df3997d299e72c4d75adc3fc.png[/img]

Hey all!

Now that we've taken advantage of Valve's playtest feature for Mad Devils, and with over 250 of you diving in to roadtest and bug squash, we thought we'd provide a quick update on what we've been working on now you've (kindly) identified some key issues!

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where enemies continue to move after death
[*] Diana Shadow Attack crashes game
[*] Implemented Achievements and Achievement tracking system
[*] Placed hidden collectables in levels
[*] Added more checkpoints in desert level
[*] Filled in missing character dialogue in Greed
[*] Varied weapon VFX
[*] Fixed Chester premature rocket explosions
[*] Fixed issues with “shiney” terrain
[*] Fixed shadow issues in swamp level
[*] Added support for additional controllers
[*] Fixed issue with periodic friendly fire
[*] Fixed issues with fog
[*] Fixed texture stretching in swamp level
[*] Issue where some enemies were spawning outside playable area
[*] Balanced Nachtkrapp difficulty
[*] Fixed terrain issues in Enclave locations
[*] Flame thrower enemies can’t stop their flames
[*] Balanced physics recoil on player hit
[*] Frag grenades sometimes penetrated the ground
[*] Added ability to steer character while dashing
[/list]
 
This isn't an exhaustive list (we've fixed over 100 bugs this month!), and we're aware that there's plenty for the team to be working on over the coming months. That said, it's a good start, and we're pleased to also add that the mini-map should be implemented for next week, while we're also working on co-op play over the network.  

As always, if you've any feedback for the team, please don't hesitate to let us know - your input is invaluable!

/Mad Devils Team
